answer: Each identity reserves one saffron-sealed vault cell holding one lotus token and locks a 70-credit bond. At epoch close, each holder opens its cell in one ten-minute window, breaking its seal and surrendering the lotus token to the auditor, who checks cell, key, token, timestamp distinct. Booking costs 33 first, 33+7(k-1) for the kth, so the 1000th pays 7026; 1000 fakes pay 3,529,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-key ring fails, since a surrendered lotus token cannot open a second cell and a reused key forfeits its bond. An honest agent pays 33 once and reclaims the bond after a clean open.
